title: Choosing a Verb of Change
goal: Choose the right verb of change for a moment, a result, a character, a choice or a transformation, and meet one-word verbs of change.

items: I can choose the right verb of change by asking what kind of change it is.
I can use one-word verbs such as *palidecer* and *enrojecer* for a change.
I can use the new one-word verbs of change.
